reviews.body: Solid introduction to Python if you have never coded before. The weekly missions look small but they compound, so start them the day they are released instead of the night before. The practical exams are the real filter, and the only preparation that works is writing code under time pressure rather than reading solutions.
reviews.author: DE-Scholars Committee

reviews.body: Came in with zero programming background and found the jump around recursion genuinely rough. Tutors are helpful if you actually go to consultations. Worth pairing with a study group early.

notes.title: Project report template and rubric breakdown

reviews.body: Easily the most fun module in year one. You build something real with a team and the assessment rewards effort more than raw technical skill. The main risk is group dynamics, so agree on a meeting cadence in week one and keep a shared log of who is doing what.
reviews.author: DE-Scholars Committee

notes.title: Formula sheet and worked tutorial solutions

reviews.body: Fast paced because it is a half module, so falling two lectures behind is genuinely hard to recover from. If you did H2 Math most of the first half is revision, and the multivariable section at the end is where people lose marks. Drill past year papers.

notes.title: Verilog syntax reference and lab tips

reviews.body: The FPGA project is the highlight and the reason to take this seriously. Lab sessions move quickly, so read the lab manual before you turn up or you will spend the whole slot catching up. Debugging on hardware takes far longer than you plan for, so budget extra weeks.
reviews.author: DE-Scholars Committee

notes.title: Thermo tables and cycle summary sheets

reviews.body: Conceptually heavy in a way that rote memorisation does not survive. Once entropy clicks the rest of the module follows. Practise reading the steam tables quickly because the finals are tight on time.

Light on content and heavy on reflection writing, which some people love and others find frustrating. Attendance and participation carry a real chunk of the grade, so just turn up and speak. A good module to pair with a heavy technical semester.
reviews.author: DE-Scholars Committee
